raw_segments.text: One of those chaps would make short work of a fellow, pick the bones clean no matter who
it was, ordinary meat for them, a corpse's meat gone bad, well in what's cheese, corpse
I read in that voyages in China that the Chinese say a white man smells like a corpse, cremation
better, priests dead against it, deviling for the other firm, wholesale burners and
Dutch oven dealers, time of the plague, quicklime fever pits to eat them, lethal chamber, ashes
to ashes, or bury at sea.
Where is that parcy tower of silence?
Eaten by birds, earth, fire, water, drowning they say is the pleasantest, see your whole
life in a flash but being brought back to life now, can't bury in the air however,
out of a flying machine, wonder does the news go about whenever a fresh one is let down,
underground communication, we learned that from them, wouldn't be surprised, regular
square feed for them, flies come before he's well dead, got wind of dig nom, they wouldn't
care about the smell of it.
Salt white crumbling mush of corpse, smell, taste like raw white turnips.
